question: Qual o valor médio do frete por estado?
generated_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(o.total_freight_value), 2) AS avg_order_freight, COUNT(o.order_id) AS delivered_orders FROM marts.fct_orders o JOIN marts.dim_customers c ON o.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_order_freight DESC LIMIT 10;
